name: LLM decode, 8B dense, BF16, batch 32, 2k context

tensor_bf16_flops.why: 2 x 8.03e9 parameters per token; attention score flops at 2k context are under 1% and left out

hbm_bytes.why: weights 16.06e9 bytes shared by a batch of 32 (5.02e8 per token) plus the KV cache read, 2048 tokens x 131072 bytes (32 layers x 8 KV heads x 128 dims x K,V x 2 bytes)

provenance.note: an example of the inference roofline: decode at this batch is memory-bound, so the score measures bytes moved, not tensor-core flops. Demand scales with batch and context; build one profile per serving configuration.
